name: mtg-deck-analyzer
description: Commander (EDH) deck analyzer: validation, mana analysis, opening-hand simulation, and EDHREC-driven upgrade suggestions.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
